arxiv-1910-06673.title: SafeCritic: Collision-Aware Trajectory Prediction
arxiv-1910-06673.creator: Tessa van der Heiden tessa.heiden@bmw.de, Naveen Shankar Nagaraja naveen-shankar.nagaraja@bmw.de, Christian Weiß christian.wc.weiss@bmw.de Efstratios Gavves egavves@uva.nl
arxiv-1910-06673.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Tessa van der Heiden tessa.heiden@bmw.de, Naveen Shankar Nagaraja naveen-shankar.nagaraja@bmw.de, Christian Weiß christian.wc.weiss@bmw.de Efstratios Gavves egavves@uva.nl. Navigating complex urban environments safely is a key to realize fully autonomous systems. Predicting future locations of vulnerable road users, such as pedestrians and cyclists, thus, has received a lot of attention in the recent years. While previous works have addressed modeling interactions with the static (obstacles) and dynamic (humans) environment agents, we address an important gap in trajectory prediction.

arxiv-2009-06464.title: Non-principal Euclidean ideal class in a family of biquadratic fields with the class number two
arxiv-2009-06464.creator: Srilakshmi Krishnamoorthy, Sunil Kumar Pasupulati
arxiv-2009-06464.description: Abstract . Lenstra introduced the notion of a Euclidean ideal class, which is a generalization of the Euclidean domain. Lenstra also proved that the Euclidean ideal in a number field K K implies that the class group of K K is cyclic. We construct a family of biquadratic fields that have a Euclidean ideal whenever the class number is 2.

arxiv-2109-07123.title: Phase retrieval for affine groups over prime fields
arxiv-2109-07123.creator: David Bartusel, Hartmut Führ, Vignon Oussa
arxiv-2109-07123.description: Abstract We study phase retrieval for group frames arising from permutation representations, focusing on the action of the affine group of a finite field. We investigate various versions of the phase retrieval problem, including conjugate phase retrieval, sign retrieval, and matrix recovery.

arxiv-2109-14893.title: Zero-Sum Stackelberg Stochastic Linear-Quadratic Differential Games
arxiv-2109-14893.creator: Jingrui Sun Hanxiao Wang Jiaqiang Wen
arxiv-2109-14893.description: Abstract Abstract. The paper is concerned with a zero-sum Stackelberg stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ, for short) differential game over finite horizons. Under a fairly weak condition, the Stackelberg equilibrium is explicitly obtained by first solving a forward stochastic LQ optimal control problem (SLQ problem, for short) and then a backward SLQ problem.

arxiv-2110-09321.title: COVIDRead: A Large-scale Question Answering Dataset on COVID-19 Journal: Knowledge-Based Systems
arxiv-2110-09321.creator: Tanik Saikh, Sovan Kumar Sahoo, Asif Ekbal, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2110-09321.description: Abstract During this pandemic situation, extracting any relevant information related to COVID-19 will be immensely beneficial to the community at large. In this paper, we present a very important resource, COVIDRead , a Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD) like dataset over more than 100k question-answer pairs. The dataset consists of Context-Answer-Question triples.

arxiv-2405-04255.title: Ruled Ricci surfaces and curves of constant torsion
arxiv-2405-04255.creator: Alcides de Carvalho, Iury Domingos and Roney Santos
arxiv-2405-04255.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alcides de Carvalho, Iury Domingos and Roney Santos. We show that all non-developable ruled surfaces endowed with Ricci metrics in the three-dimensional Euclidean space may be constructed using curves of constant torsion and its binormal. This allows us to give characterizations of the helicoid as the only surface of this kind that admits a parametrization with plane line of striction, and as the only with constant mean curvature. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 53A10 1.

arxiv-2409-01410.title: Dataset Distillation from First Principles: Integrating Core Information Extraction and Purposeful Learning
arxiv-2409-01410.creator: Vyacheslav Kungurtsev vyacheslav.kungurtsev@fel.cvut.cz, Yuanfang Peng ypengbx@connect.ust.hk, Jianyang Gu gu.1220@osu.edu, Saeed Vahidian saeed.vahidian@duke.edu, Anthony Quinn a.quinn@imperial.ac.uk, Fadwa Idlahcen idlahfad@fel.cvut.cz, Yiran Chen yiran.chen@duke.edu
arxiv-2409-01410.description: Abstract Dataset distillation (DD) is an increasingly important technique that focuses on constructing a synthetic dataset capable of capturing the core information in training data to achieve comparable performance in models trained on the latter. While DD has a wide range of applications, the theory supporting it is less well evolved.

arxiv-2504-20983.title: ltl f Adaptive Synthesis for Multi-Tier Goals in Nondeterministic Domains
arxiv-2504-20983.creator: Giuseppe De Giacomo, Gianmarco Parretti, Shufang Zhu
arxiv-2504-20983.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Giuseppe De Giacomo, Gianmarco Parretti, Shufang Zhu. We study a variant of ltl f synthesis that synthesizes adaptive strategies for achieving a multi-tier goal, consisting of multiple increasingly challenging ltl f objectives in nondeterministic planning domains. Adaptive strategies are strategies that at any point of their execution ( i ) enforce the satisfaction of as many objectives as possible in the multi-tier goal, and ( ii ) exploit possible cooperation from the environment to satisfy as many as possible of the remaining ones.

arxiv-2512-02847.title: Inflationary assessment of F ⁡ ( ℛ , ℛ ~ ) F(\mathcal{R},\tilde{\mathcal{R}}) Einstein-Cartan models
arxiv-2512-02847.creator: Theodoros Katsoulas, Kyriakos Tamvakis
arxiv-2512-02847.description: Abstract In the framework of F ⁡ ( ℛ , ℛ ~ ) F({\cal{R}},\,\tilde{\cal{R}}) Einstein-Cartan gravity with an action depending both of the Ricci scalar and the so-called Holst-invariant curvature we consider models that include cubic terms of the latter in the action and study their inflationary behavior.

doe-osti-3364534-data-for-autonomous-tra.creator: Young, Stanley E., Fish, Joseph, Mir, Faizan

europmc-pmc8938269.description: Tirzepatide is a novel, once weekly, dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist and is under development for the treatment of type 2 diabetes (T2D) and obesity. Its association with cardiovascular outcomes requires evaluation. This pre-specified cardiovascular meta-analysis included all...

pmc-10523755.title: Multiple high-risk fertility behaviours and children under five mortality survivors among ever-married women of reproductive age in Nigeria
pmc-10523755.creator: Obasanjo Afolabi Bolarinwa, Julia Marie Hajjar, Oluwatobi Abel Alawode, Kobi V Ajayi, Adedoyin Tinuoya Roberts, Sanni Yaya
pmc-10523755.description: BackgroundMultiple high-risk fertility behaviours (MHRFBs), including maternal age < 18 or > 34 years old, a birth order 4+, and birth spacing < 24 months, can directly or indirectly affect survival outcomes among under-five children. There is a dearth of available information and data about these two phenomena in Nigeria.

pmc-10669385.title: Identification of Novel Targeting Sites of Calcineurin and CaMKII in Human CaV3.2 T-Type Calcium Channel
pmc-10669385.creator: Yu-Wang Chang, Yong-Cyuan Chen, Chien-Chang Chen
pmc-10669385.description: The Cav3.2 T-type calcium channel is implicated in various pathological conditions, including cardiac hypertrophy, epilepsy, autism, and chronic pain. Phosphorylation of Cav3.2 by multiple kinases plays a pivotal role in regulating its calcium channel function. The calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase, calcineurin, interacts physically with Cav3.2 and modulates its activity. However, it remains unclear whether calcineurin dephosphorylates Cav3.

pmc-11387488.title: Identification of neutrophil extracellular trap-related biomarkers in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease through machine learning and single-cell analysis
pmc-11387488.creator: Zhihao Fang, Changxu Liu, Xiaoxiao Yu, Kai Yang, Tianqi Yu, Yanchao Ji, Chang Liu
pmc-11387488.description: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), noted for its widespread prevalence among adults, has become the leading chronic liver condition globally. Simultaneously, the annual disease burden, particularly liver cirrhosis caused by NAFLD, has increased significantly. Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETs) play a crucial role in the progression of this disease and are key to the pathogenesis of NAFLD.

pmc-11458504.title: Efficacy and Tollerability of INI-Based 2-Drug Regimen in Virosuppressed Persons Living with HIV: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11458504.creator: Antonio Russo, Salvatore Martini, Mariantonietta Pisaturo, Maria Grazia Palamone, Maria Teresa Russo, Verdiana Zollo, Roberta Palladino, Pierantonio Grimaldi, Alberto Borghetti, Giuseppe Vittorio De Socio, Massimiliano Fabbiani, Nicola Coppola
pmc-11458504.description: BackgroundThe aim of this meta-analysis was to synthesize the available evidence from the literature on the efficacy and safety of integrase inhibitor-based two drug regimens compared to triple drug regimens in virosuppressed people living with HIV (PLWH) in a long-term follow-up (at 96 weeks).

pmc-11489788.title: Intraoperative central venous pressures related to early graft function in deceased donor kidney transplant recipients with low immunological risks
pmc-11489788.creator: Hyoeun Ahn, Jun Bae Bang
pmc-11489788.description: This study aims to analyze data from patients who received kidney transplantation from deceased donors to investigate the anesthetic factors influencing early and late graft outcomes, including the incidence of slow graft function (SGF), delayed graft function (DGF), and 3-year graft outcomes. We retrospectively analyzed 202 recipients who underwent deceased donor kidney transplantation from March 2010 to December 2020.

pmc-11520782.title: Sitting foot: posture dependent changes of volume, edema and perfusion of the foot. A prospective interventional study with 27 volunteers
pmc-11520782.creator: Wolfgang Freund, Peter Wikstroem, Arthur P Wunderlich, Uwe Schuetz, Meinrad Beer
pmc-11520782.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSitting is known to be bad for your cardiovascular health. We furthermore hypothesized that sitting posture will reduce perfusion of the foot and increase edema, possibly predisposing to disease like osteochondritis.MethodsWe included 27 healthy volunteers and performed MRI measurements including arterial spin labelling (ASL) and intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM) perfusion as well as short tau inversion recovery (STIR) edema measurement and 3D volumetry.

pmc-11599874.title: The interplay of EBV virus and cell metabolism in lung cancer
pmc-11599874.creator: Hongwei Wang
pmc-11599874.description: Epstein–Barr virus infection has been implicated in various cancers, including lung cancer, where it influences cellular metabolism to promote tumorigenesis. This review examines the complex interplay between Epstein–Barr virus and cell metabolism in lung cancer, highlighting viral mechanisms of metabolic reprogramming and their implications for therapeutic strategies.

pmc-11700243.title: Fabricating ZnO@C composites based on Nypa fruticants shell-derived cellulose for high performance lithium-ion battery anodes
pmc-11700243.creator: Quang Quoc Viet Thieu, Thi Hoang Thy Tran, Hai Dang Ngo, Liem Thanh Pham, Man Van Tran, Ngoc Quang Tran, Nguyen Phuc Thien Le, Dinh Quan Nguyen, Tuan Loi Nguyen, Il Tae Kim
pmc-11700243.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this study, Nypa fruticans shell-derived cellulose was successfully produced, and the hydrothermal method was employed to generate ZnO@C (ZOC) composites, which were then subjected to calcination in N2 gas at a temperature of 600 °C for varying durations. X-ray diffraction and thermogravimetric analyses demonstrated that the annealing duration had a substantial impact on the quantities of C and ZnO in the ZOC composites.

pmc-12496545.title: Knowledge and Attitudes Regarding Childhood Hearing Loss Among Parents in Western Saudi Arabia
pmc-12496545.creator: Manar Alghamdi, Sarah S Almohammdi, Noor S Alharbi, Fatimah Klantan, Zubida Binsiddiq, Mahmoud Alreefi, Malak J Gazzaz, Naif A Bawazeer
pmc-12496545.description: Childhood hearing loss (HL) can severely hinder social, cognitive, and communication skills. Parental awareness and knowledge have a significant impact on the results and repercussions. The purpose of this study is to assess parents' attitudes and knowledge about childhood HL in Western Saudi Arabia.The questionnaire was adapted from a previously validated survey.

pmc-12564644.title: Nanobiosensors for Single-Molecule Diagnostics: Toward Integration with Super-Resolution Imaging
pmc-12564644.creator: Seungah Lee, Sobia Rafiq, Seong Ho Kang
pmc-12564644.description: Recent advances in nanotechnology and optical imaging have transformed molecular diagnostics, enabling the detection and analysis of individual biomolecules with unprecedented precision. Nanobiosensors provide ultrasensitive molecular detection, and super-resolution microscopy (SRM) exceeds the diffraction limit of conventional optics to achieve nanometer-scale resolution.

pmc-12731572.title: Anemia as a Part of the Triple Burden Among Children Under-Five with Stunting and Tuberculosis in Bandung, Indonesia
pmc-12731572.creator: Susi Susanah, Delita Prihatni, Rini Rossanti, Safira Satyani Lutfia, Fadhila Novianti, Fedri Ruluwedrata Rinawan, Diah Asri Wulandari, Muhammad Akbar Tirtosudiro, Citra Cesilia, Sri Sudarwati, Cissy Rachiana Sudjana Prawira, Heda Melinda Nataprawira, Ahad Ahmed Kodipad, Ganesh Yadaigiri
pmc-12731572.description: Highlights What are the main findings? •Anemia is highly prevalent among children under five in Indonesia, either as a single condition or in coexistence with other morbidities such as stunting and tuberculosis. These health issues represent critical public health challenges, as this triple burden can affect their quality of growth and development in the future.

pmc-13187952.title: Development and Optimization of CRISPR/Cas9-Assisted Recombineering in Escherichia albertii
pmc-13187952.creator: Shahab Ahmad Khan, Tara Marie Miller, Shantanu Bhatt, Edwin Li
pmc-13187952.description: Escherichia albertii is a zoonotic pathogen frequently misidentified as diarrheagenic E. coli due to shared phenotypic and genetic traits, yet functional genomic studies in this species have been limited by the inefficiency of traditional genetic tools. To address this, we developed a bipartite CRISPR/Cas9-assisted lambda red (𝛌-Red) recombineering system for efficient, markerless genome editing in E. albertii .

pmc-13358569.title: Balloon-expandable trilayer nitrided iron/Zn/poly-D,L-lactic acid metallic tracheal stent: structural characterization, mechanical performance, and short-term safety evaluation in rabbits
pmc-13358569.creator: Hao Wang, Qiqi Hu, Wenxin Cao, Zihao Bai, Wanxuan Song, Xingtong Chen, Di Yu, Zhaocong Yang, Huilin Li, Chen Chen, Yuzhong Yang, Xuming Mo
pmc-13358569.description: BackgroundPediatric airway stenosis and tracheomalacia may require airway stenting to maintain patency. However, conventional metallic or silicone airway stents are associated with frequent complications such as granulation, mucus plugging, and migration. Although bioresorbable polymer stents reduce long-term indwelling, degradation fragments may still pose a risk of airway obstruction.

pmc-13412885.title: Antimicrobial Agents in Fibrous Materials: A Comprehensive Review of Natural, Inorganic, and Organic Systems
pmc-13412885.creator: Xueyan Que, Junqing Bai, Hai Yao, Pingping Fu, Yuanbo Xu, Xiaoyan Zhang, Yuqing Cui, Yingting Li, Jiangtao Yu, Ling Xu
pmc-13412885.description: The escalating threat of antimicrobial resistance has spurred extensive research into antimicrobial fibers. While numerous reviews have comprehensively cataloged the classification and mechanisms of natural, inorganic, and organic antimicrobial agents, a critical gap remains: few have systematically evaluated the engineering strategies that translate intrinsic biocidal activity into durable, real-world fiber performance.
